summary: Comprehensive frontend-only QA pass over the CEECO HDPE PIPES static SPA covering all 22 review items across Home, About, Products, Quality, Contact, Careers, Header, Footer, mobile drawer and WhatsApp button. All major spec items are correctly implemented. Both mock forms (Contact & Careers) submit successfully and show success toasts via sonner. Infrastructure and Gallery routes are gone from navbar/footer. All asset images (FACTORY, BLUEDUCT, ISO, MSME) are loaded from customer-assets.emergentagent.com. No em dashes found anywhere. All 7 PN ratings + PE 80/PE 100 grades appear on Home, Products and (PNs implicit) Quality. Sameer D Ruparel rendered without a period. Quality 'Working Towards' section contains only BIS and ISI cards. No 'Download Spec' buttons present.

issues: Accessibility console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen reader users.' Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to /app/frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx SheetContent to silence Radix UI a11y warning. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside the mobile menu Sheet in Header.jsx to remove the Radix UI a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx mobile Sheet is missing a DialogTitle - Radix prints an a11y console warning on every mobile menu open. Wrap with @radix-ui/react-visually-hidden or shadcn VisuallyHidden.

Routes for /infrastructure and /gallery return the SPA index.html (HTTP 200) with empty content area because no <Route> matches and no catch-all/NotFound exists. This satisfies the 'not reachable from nav' spec, but consider adding a wildcard NotFound route or a redirect to / for a cleaner UX if a user lands there from an old bookmark.

site.js still has placeholder address values '[Your Office Address]' / '[Your Factory Address]' rendered visibly in the footer and on the Contact page - replace before launch (this is intentional per the brief, just flagging).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope spec items verified passing

test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a fully static React SPA with two mocked forms (Contact, Careers) using sonner toasts. Use data-testid selectors throughout: contact-name/email/message/submit, careers-name/phone/email/message/role-trigger/submit, mobile-menu-button, mobile-nav-link-*, nav-link-*, nav-contact-cta, whatsapp-button, footer-phone, footer-copyright, footer-hours, site-header, site-footer, contact-form, careers-form. Do NOT use input[name=...] selectors - the Inputs use id+placeholder, no name attribute. For the careers role field use the shadcn Select (data-testid=careers-role-trigger) and click a [role='option']. All 22 spec items verified directly against the live https://ceeco-hdpe.preview.emergentagent.com URL and HTML source. Note that several text strings render with line-breaks/spans (e.g., 'Photo' / 'Coming Soon' on two lines, '9+' / 'Sizes' stacked) so use page.content() / HTML-level checks instead of inner_text() when validating those phrases.
